title: Frozen mixed cohort for Chandra shadow qualification
question: Which finite exact inputs and independent source checks will cover the specialist and routing comparison?
method: Use retained native NIST and Forbes controls where available. Fill gaps with public native and natural scanned inputs. Inspect original pixels, PDF widget identity, and source text before evaluating Chandra. Keep the known NIST PRI controls separate from held-out natural inputs.

conclusion: The frozen cohort and source expectations are ready for incumbent and Chandra runs. Candidate delivery, native form comparison, semantic correctness, and operating-policy conclusions remain separate obligations.
